release_notes: Added the first real MOOR Generator Generator vertical slice inside COLONY.
One generator request can now become 2-8 genuinely different architecture candidates with explicit contracts, constraints, tests, risks and unknown budgets.
Candidate test/benchmark gates start UNMEASURED and cannot be promoted with invented results; real hardware/workload evidence is required.
Comparison uses Pareto dominance across recorded p95 latency, peak memory, quality and failure rate rather than hiding tradeoffs behind one magic score.
Failures now create reproducible Failure Packets, repair candidates, permanent regression cases and draft reusable lessons.
Verified lessons are fed into later generator builder handoffs when relevant. Commands: mgg, generator generator, build generator <idea>, generators, failure library, lessons.
